title: Keeping things organised
intro: Folders, filters and Trash keep your files easy to find. To add a folder, see “Adding files and folders”.

sections.heading: Work on several items at once
text: Select files and folders, and the selection bar appears above the list.
steps: Click the checkbox at the start of each row you want.
Click **Move to folder…**, then click a folder to move everything into it.
Click **Move to library…** to move everything you selected to another library.
Click **Delete** to move everything you selected to Trash.

sections.heading: Rename or move one item
steps: Click the three dots at the end of the row.
Click **Rename…**, type the new name and click **OK**.
bullets: The same menu has **Move to folder…**, and you can also drag a row onto a folder in the list.
Renaming a folder does not change who it is shared with.

sections.heading: Delete, undo and restore
text: Deleted files go to Trash, so you can get them back.
steps: Click **Undo** if you change your mind. It stays until you close it or Depot shows another message.
bullets: Later, click **Trash** in the left rail. The page is called **Recycle bin**.
Click **Restore** next to the file you want back.
sections.note: Deleting a folder asks you to confirm first, because it can end sharing on that folder.

sections.heading: Filter, sort and change the view
bullets: Click **All types** and choose a type, such as **Images**, to show only those files.
Click **Name**, **Size** or **Modified** at the top of the list to sort by it. Click again to reverse it.
Drag the slider next to **Details** to the right for tiles, or to the left for a list.
